_comment: MCP server registrations for AdministrateMe Executor. The GitHub MCP server provides native tools for repo state, PRs, issues. Claude Code reads this at session start. Note: the Executor primarily uses git/gh CLI for repo operations; MCP is for richer queries (e.g., reading PR diffs, listing issue threads) when needed inline.

github._comment: Official GitHub MCP server. github/github-mcp-server. Provides ~50 tools across repos / issues / pull_requests / code_security toolsets. We scope to those four to keep the tool surface small.
